name: APFC Panels
seoTitle: APFC Panel Manufacturer in Kolkata | AM Electricals
seoDescription: Thyristor and detuned APFC panels, 25 to 800 kVAR, IEC 61439-2. Built in Kolkata. Free PF audit across West Bengal, Jharkhand and Odisha.
features: Thyristor zero-point switching. No inrush current, no capacitor stress on switching
Detuned reactor options at 7% and 14% for VFD-heavy loads
Auto changeover between EB and DG source, no manual reset
Powder-coated CRCA enclosure built for Bengal humidity
Reference designs CPRI type-tested at 6000A
overview: Power factor below 0.95 draws a penalty on most industrial tariffs. An APFC panel switches capacitor banks in steps to hold the plant's power factor near unity automatically, no manual switching. Thyristor-switched stages avoid the capacitor inrush that blows fuses on contactor-switched panels; detuned reactors are added where harmonic-heavy loads like VFDs and UPS are already on the bus.

Vertical bus spacing rated for the fault level, not the datasheet minimum
Type-tested reference designs available on request
overview: An MCC groups every motor starter on a plant or floor into one panel, each feeder isolated behind its own door so one motor fault or maintenance job doesn't need a full shutdown. Form 4b segregation keeps live busbar separated from the feeder compartment — the detail that actually gets checked in a safety audit.

name: PCC Panels

seoDescription: Power Control Centre panels up to 4000 A at 415 V, 3-phase 4-wire. IS 8623, 70 kA / 1s. Single or double front, load scheduling built in.
features: Load scheduling drops non-critical feeders first when EB or DG is overloaded
CRCA sheet with powder coat, not painted MS. Bengal-climate rated
Incoming and outgoing feeder layout planned around your operator, not our drawing template
ACB or MCCB incomer to consultant spec
overview: A PCC sits upstream of the MCC, taking the incoming supply and splitting it into outgoing feeders for distribution boards, large motors and the MCC itself. At this current rating a fault has to clear in cycles not seconds, so busbar bracing and breaker discrimination are checked against the full prospective short-circuit current, not just the panel's own rating.

EB fail auto-transfer and auto-restore, tuned to your no-break window
Controller-agnostic. We wire on the brand your service engineer already carries

overview: An AMF panel's only job is to start the standby genset and transfer load the moment mains fails, then transfer back and shut down cleanly when mains returns. Sync panels add the extra step of phase-matching multiple DGs, or a DG to the grid, before closing the breaker — get that wrong and you're closing two live sources out of phase onto the same bus.
